reference.original: Reuse frozen original scoring clouds and passed pair gate; original target is unchanged
reference.transformed: Full-data MH HMC in new anchor whitening,8 leapfrog steps; warmup adaptation only

selection: One fixed(n,h) per method per version: among full-horizon zero-failure pilot configurations, minimize mean setup-inclusive warm time to joint SW2<=.3 and variance_NRMSE<=.5 across two seeds and both refs; tie n,h,K lexical. If none, select smallest max(SW2/.3,NRMSE/.5) at8192, label fallback, no pilot attainment claimed. Freeze before validation.
failure_rule: Any failed replica in any pilot/validation seed invalidates that complete configuration at all checkpoints; never remove failed replicas to score survivors. Failure threshold unchanged100sqrt(d).
cost: Local anchor+prepare/state setup+synchronized sampling; cold adds measured shape compilation, cache/order effects acknowledged. Functions/scoring/storage/reference construction excluded from sampler ranking, separately recorded.
metrics: Existing endpoint replica standardizedSW2 and ergodic relative-variance NRMSE, worse of reference-specific seed means. Four validation seeds are small diagnostic evidence, not replacement for original P3A.
scope: Bounded common grid and independent validation; no further tuning or gate lowering. Reference failure stops that version. No pooled ranking across distinct targets.
